text:
maria: quick proposal — alternate launch path for observability. instead of bundling full tracing hooks + dashboards + cost breakdown in one release, split into two small launches to reduce infra risk and get customer value faster.

aj: ✅ agree — what do you see in release A vs B?

maria: release A (fast): per-route cost breakdown, error-rate panels, basic alerting, and a lightweight sampling toggle. target: 4 week build, low infra changes. release B (follow): full tracing hooks, span tags for tenant attribution, and trace heatmap/latency waterfall. target: next quarter.

devon: flag — customers (ACME + HealthCo) asked for trace correlation to debug cost anomalies. will they accept delayed tracing?

maria: spoke with ACME — they'd prefer cost visibility first (they can triage most issues) and will opt into tracing beta later. HealthCo needs stricter retention/KMS but tracing can be gated by Private customers only.

karim: SRE note — big risk is trace ingestion spike causing autoscaler thrash. splitting helps. also we need a graceful fallback: if trace rate > 15% of baseline, flip to sampling=0.1.

sre-bot: automated note — added alert: trace-ingest-rate > 1.15 * baseline for 10m -> pager to eng-oncall.

lio: UX ask — for release A, can we surface per-route token-cost in the same panel as error rate? customers want quick correlation. maybe a small inline sparkline and a sample query.

maria: yes — mockup attached in Figma (link). plan: single card with toggles: cost / error / requests. keep charts lightweight (no trace joins).

aj: acceptance criteria draft?

maria: adding checklist:```
Acceptance checklist for Release A:
- Cost panels: per-route + per-model token breakdown (last 24h, 7d)
- Error analytics: grouped by error code + top stack traces (sanitized)
- Alerts: per-tenant cost spike + error-rate SLO breach
- Performance: dashboard load < 500ms for 90th percentile
- Rollout: beta to 5 customers, opt-in toggle per org
- Fallback: sampling toggle and autoscaler guardrails
```

devon: perf SLA is aggressive — suggest 1s P90 for initial beta otherwise we'll spend cycles. can we scope down the default time range to 24h to help?

maria: ok, change Perf to P90 < 1s for beta; GA target 500ms.

karim: question about cost calc: should token cost be normalized to model family (quantized) or raw token pricing? ops likes a normalized view for comparisons.

lio: UX prefers normalized cost per-token with ability to view raw billing numbers (toggle).

aj: next steps: 1) confirm resource estimate from eng-runtime by EOD Thu; 2) SRE to simulate trace spike scenarios; 3) product to write PRD with acceptance checklist and rollout plan.

maria: assigned — I'll open PRD and add mocks. tagging @aj and @karim for signoff by Fri. :thumbsup:

karim: noted. will run canary sim and post results in this thread.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: canary test scheduled for 2025-11-12 03:00 UTC.

maria: thanks team — keeping scope tight should get more customer value early and reduce launch friction. anyone object?

lio: no objections. happy to iterate on the card UX after beta feedback.

aj: no objections. moving to action items.

maria: closing thread and will follow up with PRD link shortly.
